## Response Timeframes (FCA Requirements)  
**Maximum Response Times:**  
| Complaint Type | Timeframe | Escalation |
|---|---|---|
| Simple (resolve quickly) | 1 business day | Manager if escalated |
| Standard | 8 calendar days | Director if unresolved |
| Complex | 8 weeks (FCA extension) | FCA notification if exceeded |  
**8-Week Clock:**
- Starts: When complaint received
- Stops: When response sent to customer
- Can be extended 8 weeks if: Complex investigation justified, customer agrees

raw_entities.name: Complaints Response Timeframe Policy
raw_entities.description: A formal policy section governing the maximum response times for customer complaints, aligned with FCA regulatory requirements. It establishes distinct timeframes for simple, standard, and complex complaints, defines escalation paths, and mandates an 8-week clock mechanism with specific start/stop rules and extension conditions.

raw_entities.name: Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) Requirements
raw_entities.description: Regulatory guidance and directives issued by the FCA that mandate specific complaint response timeframes, extension procedures, and notification obligations for banking institutions. The policy explicitly derives its 8-week clock rules and escalation requirements from these FCA standards.

raw_entities.name: Simple Complaint Resolution within 1 Business Day
raw_entities.description: Mandates that simple complaints must be resolved within a maximum of 1 business day. This is a strict operational deadline requiring prompt action from frontline staff to ensure rapid customer resolution.

raw_entities.name: Standard Complaint Resolution within 8 Calendar Days
raw_entities.description: Requires that standard complaints be resolved within a maximum of 8 calendar days. This timeframe applies to non-complex customer disputes requiring routine investigation and internal review.

raw_entities.name: Complex Complaint Resolution within 8 Weeks with FCA Extension
raw_entities.description: Sets a maximum response timeframe of 8 weeks for complex complaints, with an explicit provision allowing an additional 8-week extension if justified by the investigation complexity and agreed upon by the customer.

raw_entities.name: Mandatory Escalation to Manager for Simple Complaints
raw_entities.description: Obliges staff to escalate simple complaints to a Manager if they cannot be resolved within the initial 1 business day timeframe. Ensures appropriate oversight for unresolved straightforward disputes.

raw_entities.name: Mandatory Escalation to Director for Unresolved Standard Complaints
raw_entities.description: Requires that standard complaints be escalated to a Director if they remain unresolved within the 8 calendar day window. Provides senior-level review for complex or persistent customer issues.

raw_entities.name: FCA Notification upon Exceeding Complex Timeframe
raw_entities.description: Mandates formal notification to the FCA if a complex complaint investigation exceeds the standard 8-week response timeframe. Ensures regulatory transparency and compliance with external reporting standards for delayed resolutions.

raw_entities.name: 8-Week Clock Start and Stop Rules
raw_entities.description: Defines the operational mechanics of the 8-week regulatory clock: it starts when a complaint is received and stops when a formal response is sent to the customer. This ensures accurate tracking of compliance deadlines and prevents arbitrary extensions.
context: Stops: When response sent to customer

raw_entities.name: Extension of 8-Week Clock with Customer Agreement
raw_entities.description: Permits an extension of the 8-week clock by a maximum of 8 additional weeks, contingent upon a justified complex investigation and explicit agreement from the customer. Balances regulatory deadlines with practical investigative needs.
context: Can be extended 8 weeks if: Complex investigation justified, customer agrees

raw_entities.name: Manager
raw_entities.description: An abstract escalation role responsible for reviewing and resolving simple complaints that exceed the initial 1 business day resolution window. Holds authority to manage escalated customer disputes and ensure timely closure.

raw_entities.name: Director
raw_entities.description: An abstract escalation role responsible for handling standard complaints that remain unresolved after 8 calendar days. Holds senior authority to review, approve, or resolve escalated customer matters.

raw_entities.name: Financial Conduct Authority (FCA)
raw_entities.description: The external regulatory body responsible for setting complaint response timeframes, approving extensions, and receiving notifications when complex investigations exceed mandated deadlines. Acts as the oversight authority for policy compliance.

raw_entities.name: Customer
raw_entities.description: The recipient of formal complaint responses and the party whose agreement is required to extend the 8-week investigation clock. Policy obligations are directly structured around timely communication with, resolution for, and consent from the customer.
